items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Blossom Dearie who I had been in Alvino Rey’s group with

ctx.x: Yeah and I lived on 54th and I didn’t know it, I was still living with my mother at the time and… Blossom Dearie who I had been in Alvino Rey’s group with, she came in as the lead singer. She had been with Woody before that and I just didn’t believe her.
I can’t imagine her as a band singer.
